description: Frozen representative-workload corpus for the M3 indexing/event-loop experiment. Pins synthetic workload descriptors with predeclared event-loop delay, p99 latency, and RSS budgets; workerization/incremental work remains gated behind M3's frozen-threshold disposition.

cases.query: full index of a small synthetic corpus stays within the frozen event-loop budget
full index of a large synthetic corpus stays within the frozen event-loop budget
incremental graph refresh under a burst of concurrent file-change events
sustained concurrent search/retrieve load on a warm large-corpus index
